Class PdfReportMaker.Canvas

java.lang.Object
com.example.export.PdfReportMaker.Canvas
Enclosing class:
PdfReportMaker
private static class PdfReportMaker.Canvas extends Object
Keeps track of the current page and how far down it has been written, and starts a new page automatically when there is no room left.
Author:
Ubayd Razack Draws a ReportData as a PDF report using Apache PDFBox ReportData.
